resources.string: Windy Weather uses your approximate location to fetch local weather and determine the displayed place name. If you continue, rounded coordinates are sent over HTTPS to Open-Meteo and passed to your device’s Android system geocoding service when you refresh and automatically as often as every 15 minutes. The system geocoding provider may process the request off-device. Coordinates, weather details, and a coordinate-matched place name are stored locally until you turn this feature off. Open-Meteo may retain API logs containing coordinates for up to 90 days. Moon phase is calculated on this device. You can withdraw consent at any time in settings.
